name: weekly_returns_trailing_avg
description: Weekly returns with a four-week trailing average

definition.population: Store returns in the last 16 weeks
definition.formula: WITH weekly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', SR_RETURNED_DATE) AS week_start, COUNT(*) AS returns FROM TPCDS.PUBLIC.STORE_RETURNS WHERE SR_RETURNED_DATE >= DATEADD('week', -16, CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY 1), with_avg AS (SELECT week_start, returns, ROUND(AVG(returns) OVER (ORDER BY week_start ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 1) AS avg_4w FROM weekly) SELECT week_start AS "Week", returns AS "Returns", avg_4w AS "4W Trailing Avg" FROM with_avg ORDER BY week_start
